title: Staged scene set
description: A set of theatre-of-the-mind scenes: which artwork carries each location, who is standing in it, and how they are arranged. Consumed twice — by tools/stage-assets/stage_assets.py, which resizes each named source out of artwork/in-tray/ into the module under its stable id, and by the module's own buildStageDemoScenes, which turns each entry into a real Foundry Scene with its cast staged. See design/theatre-of-the-mind-staging.md.

portraits.description: The cast pool. `id` is the CONTRACT: everything downstream points at assets/stage/<id>.webp, so when the asset-review-pipeline reorganises artwork/in-tray/ only `source` has to move.

characterRef.description: id of a file under data/characters/ or data/npcs/, when this portrait is of somebody who exists there. null for a role that has no sheet.

faction.description: Faction id ref (matches data/factions/*.json's `id`), or null for unaffiliated. Drives the Splash tier's accent colour via core/splash.mjs's FACTION_ACCENTS — an id with no entry there stays monochrome, same as null.

standing.description: Optional one-line subtitle for the Splash tier (design/theatre-of-the-mind-staging.md §5: 'name, designation, affiliation, maybe a single line of standing... not stats'). null renders nothing extra.

source.description: Path relative to artwork/in-tray/. Expected to change; the id is not.

layout.description: Blocking is meaning: two figures either side of a gap read as a conversation, a cluster opposite one figure reads as a summons. Must match core/stage-layout.mjs's STAGE_LAYOUTS.

transition.description: Optional. Passed straight through to the Foundry Scene's own transition.{type,duration,activeOnly} field (design/theatre-of-the-mind-staging.md §6) — not our own vocabulary, Foundry's. Absent means Foundry's own default (fade). A type this build doesn't recognise falls back to fade silently, so this is always a safe field to set.

type.description: A CONFIG.Canvas.sceneTransitions key — one of the 13 shipped types (fade, swirl, waterDrop, morph, crosshatch, wind, waves, whiteNoise, hologram, hole, holeSwirl, glitch, dots) or a custom one this module registers.

side.description: An explicit placement always wins over the layout — a Director who has placed somebody has made a directing decision.

revealed.description: false keeps this member GM-side entirely: they are absent from the Scene flag every client receives, not merely undrawn (doctrine Law 11).
